groups.name_vi: Bảo mật & hạn chế cạnh tranh

matching: NFKC + gộp khoảng trắng/xuống dòng, không phân biệt hoa/thường; hit đầu tiên hợp lệ của mỗi rule trên mỗi clause

rules.name: indemnification
rules.pat: indemnif\w*|\b(?:hold(?:s|ing)?|held)\b[^.]{0,40}\bharmless|bồi thường|bồi hoàn
rules.desc: A party must indemnify or hold another party harmless.

rules.name: unlimited_liability
rules.pat: unlimited liability|liability[^.]{0,40}\bunlimited|without (?:any )?(?:limit|cap)\b|no (?:limit|cap) on (?:its |the |such )?liabilit\w*|trách nhiệm (?:vô hạn|không giới hạn)|không giới hạn (?:mức )?trách nhiệm
rules.desc: Liability is stated as unlimited or without a cap.

rules.name: liability_exclusion
rules.pat: (?:consequential|punitive|indirect|incidental|special|exemplary) damages|in no event[^.]{0,80}liable|thiệt hại (?:gián tiếp|đặc biệt|do hậu quả)
rules.desc: Clause excludes or limits liability for some kinds of damages.

rules.name: arbitration_or_jury_waiver
rules.pat: arbitrat|waive[^.]{0,60}jury|trọng tài
rules.desc: Disputes go to arbitration, or the right to a jury trial is waived.

rules.name: exclusive_venue
rules.pat: (?<!non-)(?<!non )\bexclusive (?:venue|jurisdiction)|thẩm quyền độc quyền
rules.desc: Disputes are limited to an exclusive venue or jurisdiction.

rules.name: acceleration
rules.pat: \baccelerat(?:e[ds]?|ion|ing)\b|(?:immediately|forthwith)(?: be| become)? due and payable|due and payable (?:immediately|forthwith)|đến hạn thanh toán ngay|thanh toán ngay lập tức toàn bộ
rules.desc: Amounts may be accelerated or become immediately due.

rules.name: penalty_or_forfeiture
rules.pat: liquidated damages|penalt(?:y|ies)|forfeit\w*|phạt vi phạm|tiền phạt|tịch thu|mất (?:tiền )?đặt cọc
rules.desc: Clause imposes liquidated damages, a penalty or a forfeiture.

rules.name: severance_obligation
rules.pat: severance|trợ cấp thôi việc|trợ cấp mất việc
rules.desc: Clause creates a severance payment obligation.

rules.name: termination_without_cause
rules.pat: without cause|(?:may|right to|shall have the right to)[^.]{0,40}terminat\w*[^.]{0,80}(?:for any reason|at any time|for convenience|at (?:its|his|her|their) (?:sole )?convenience)|at any time[^.,;]{0,40}(?:may|right to)[^.,;]{0,20}terminat\w*|đơn phương chấm dứt|chấm dứt[^.]{0,40}bất (?:cứ )?lúc nào|không cần (?:nêu )?lý do
rules.desc: A party may terminate without cause or at any time.

rules.name: auto_renewal
rules.pat: automatic(?:ally)?(?: be)? (?:renew|extend)|(?:renew|extend)\w*[^.]{0,40}\bautomatically|automatic renewal|\bevergreen\b|successive[^.]{0,40}(?:period|term)s?|tự động (?:gia hạn|kéo dài|tái tục)
rules.desc: The term renews or extends automatically.

rules.name: sole_discretion
rules.pat: \b(?:sole|absolute)(?: and (?:absolute|exclusive))? discretion|toàn quyền quyết định
rules.desc: A party decides in its sole discretion.

rules.name: change_in_control_trigger
rules.pat: change (?:in|of) control|thay đổi quyền kiểm soát
rules.desc: A change of control triggers rights, payments or other consequences.

rules.name: unilateral_amendment
rules.pat: (?:may|shall have the right to|reserves? the right to)[^.]{0,40}(?:amend|modify|change|revise)[^.]{0,80}(?:without (?:(?:the|any|prior|written|further|such) )*(?:(?:[\w-]+ ){0,2}[\w-]+['’]s? )?(?:consent|notice)|sole discretion)|unilaterally (?:amend|modify|change|revise)\w*|đơn phương (?:sửa đổi|thay đổi)
rules.desc: A party may amend the terms unilaterally.

rules.name: tax_gross_up
rules.pat: gross(?:ed)?[- ]?up\b|additional amounts as may be necessary
rules.desc: A party must gross up payments for taxes.

rules.name: compliance_obligation
rules.pat: compl(?:y|ies|iance|ying) with[^.]{0,60}\b(?:laws?|regulations?)\b|violation of (?:any |all |applicable )*(?:laws?|regulations?)\b|tuân thủ[^.]{0,60}(?:pháp luật|quy định)|vi phạm (?:pháp luật|quy định)
rules.desc: Clause requires compliance with laws or regulations, or addresses a violation.

rules.name: non_compete
rules.pat: non[- ]?compet(?:e|ition)\b|(?:shall|will) not[^.]{0,120}\bcompet(?:e|ing|ition)\b|agrees? not to[^.]{0,80}\bcompet(?:e|ing)\b|không cạnh tranh|cấm cạnh tranh
rules.desc: Clause restricts a party from competing (non-compete).

rules.name: non_solicit
rules.pat: non[- ]?solicit\w*|no[- ]solicit\w*|(?:shall|will) not[^.]{0,80}solicit|agrees? not to[^.]{0,80}solicit|không lôi kéo|không (?:chào mời|dụ dỗ)
rules.desc: Clause restricts soliciting employees or customers.

rules.name: confidentiality_obligation
rules.pat: \bconfidential\w*|proprietary information|trade secrets?|non-?disclos\w*|bảo mật|bí mật kinh doanh|thông tin mật
rules.desc: Clause imposes a confidentiality or non-disclosure duty.

rules.name: assignment_or_delegation
rules.pat: \b(?:may|shall not|will not|not)\b[^.]{0,40}(?:\bassign(?:ment)?\b|\bbe assigned\b|\bdelegat(?:e|ed|ion)\b|\bsubcontract\w*|transfer (?:its|his|her|any|all) (?:rights|interests?|obligations))|\bsubcontract\w*|\bfreely assign\w*|chuyển nhượng|thầu phụ
rules.desc: Clause allows, restricts or conditions assignment, delegation or subcontracting.

rules.name: third_party_reliance
rules.pat: third[- ]part(?:y|ies)|bên thứ ba
rules.desc: Clause involves rights, duties or actions of third parties.

missing_section_rules.name: missing_governing_law
missing_section_rules.desc: Agreement has no governing law / dispute clause.
missing_section_rules.fallback: governing law|governed by|choice of law|jurisdiction|arbitrat|luật áp dụng|pháp luật điều chỉnh|giải quyết tranh chấp|trọng tài|tòa án

missing_section_rules.name: missing_term_termination
missing_section_rules.desc: Agreement has no term / termination clause.

missing_section_rules.name: missing_breach_liabilities
missing_section_rules.desc: Agreement has no breach / liability clause.
